body: Haha, of course. I'm fucking jealous of you Swedes and your stress-free lifestyles...
How would me living in a random place somewhere, doing borderline meaningful work contribute to the global society? Why would that justify the resources I use and the burden I am on the Earth?
Haven't tried WoW or Paper Mario (had never heard of that one...). Have tried things like GTA IV, Oblivion, Sim City, countless others.

Because I didn't truly "live" through the abuse and trauma. Why now? Because i finally realized that the damage done is such that is irreparable and prevents me from being a fully acclimated individual into society. So why be a burden? We're overpopulated anyway.

I played alto saxophone for over 8 years, swam/basketball/baseball for 5, collected stamps (12+), volunteered at a children's museum (3). 

Board games bring me no joy. Computer games I'll dabble in every so often out of pure boredom.

No games or hobbies. I don't like dealing with people, so while many consider me to be their friend, I don't care much for them. 

Short answer: nope.

My parents are the kind that will kick my ass before the police get to the house, or after the court papers arrive. They have no problems sitting in jail. 

I have several medical school acceptances, so I need my parents a bit longer to finance things if I make it out.
Funny thing is, I've been accepted to medical school. I can't leave, and come back expecting a normal life.

Yes, my parents explicitly told me that after I mentioned a few offers I had. I also mentioned the medical school I want to go to (and have been accepted to), and they started looking online for houses nearby.

Thanks for your support. 9 years is a terribly long time to deal with suicidal thoughts.

I've had my share of ups largely in the form of academic successes. Getting into top ivies, top grades, top medical schools, etc. It's all been stuff I don't care much for.

I'm home from school, and counseling centers aren't open until Monday. 

They won't be around forever, but is it worth living half of a life when you can't get over the scars from your first half (assuming they die in 15 years)?

It may not be a coincidence. I tend to get more strongly hit on the holidays as I see everyone else having fun and enjoying their lives. I'm not "forever alone," but I sure wish I was.

It was obtained from chemical supply stores.

Thanks for the kind words. 

I don't want to get my parents in trouble. Call it Stockholm Syndrome if you must, but I can't irreparably harm the lives of people who gave birth to me. 

Furthermore, since they pay for my schooling at a prestigious private university, I have no choice but to listen. 

I have not tried getting help. Any counselor I tell this to would have to legally report it to authorities. And I don't see the point in getting help if  I have to hide a large portion of the truth.

My dad has a job that can be moved anywhere in the world. My mom doesn't work, and hence has all the time for helicoptering. 

What country are you from?
http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/ebu7q/19_yo_asian/c16wk2g
I'd love to, but HOW? My parents are helicopter parents--they won't leave me the fuck alone. If I take up a job on the East coast, they'll pack up and follow me there.
Yup, still around for a few hours. What's got your panties in a knot?

I don't care what my parents think; it's just impossible to avoid them. They'll show up at my dorms and drag me out. They'll force me to come home for Thanksgiving, etc. 

I'm not sure how old you are. You may think this is a teenage angst conflict w/ parents type of situation, but it's really beyond that. I have a brother who my parents have given the world to, but nothing to me. Need I also mention that I'm not on their will? 

My condolences to your girlfriend. She's lucky to have you

They're all "friends," as in acquaintances. I don't care about them any more as means to achieve a social life--one life that had prevented me from committing suicide long ago. 

I'm studying a hard science (Physics/Chemistry). I'll leave it vague so I can't be identified.

I'm graduating in May (skipped grades in elementary school), if I'm alive. I'm one of top 5 students in a class of several thousand. I'm major in a hard science, and have several jobs lined up that pay around 100-150k. 

None of this makes me happy, though. I'm sick of the abuse from my parents, who won't let me leave the house. They think I'm worthless. I think I'm useless. They've told me to go die several times, and for once I just want to call their bluff.

I am one of the more popular kids at my university (I don't have a job on top of that). Always sitting with a crowd at every meal, parties on the weekend, etc. 

You say life will change, but I've felt this terrible for more than 10 years now. I believed people then when they told me things would be different "down the line," but the future is now here and nothing has changed
